title: Aries — The Turbulent Week Ahead
script_text: Brace your fire sign for a turbulent week that ignites hidden passions and forces bold choices. Early in the week, Mars in Aries forms a trine to Jupiter in your 10th House, boosting career and prompting raises. A square from Mercury in Cancer to Neptune in your 7th House sparks confusion in love, peaking on Monday. Mid‑week, Venus moves into your 5th House, sextiling Saturn in the 1st, turning cautious love into bold self‑expression. From Thursday, the Moon opposes Pluto in your 4th House, creating emotional turbulence around home and family. A weekend trine between Mars in Leo and Venus in your 7th House sparks unexpected dates and passionate connection. Wednesday powers you as Venus enters your 5th House. Monday drains as Mercury’s square to Neptune clouds talk and saps energy. Meet a mentor Thursday to turn career ideas into action. Follow for updates daily.
